name: set_develop
description: Edit a photo (one undo step each for values and settings). `values` sets sliders by control id (see list_controls), e.g. {"light.exposure": 0.7, "light.contrast": 20}. `settings` deep-merges a partial develop-settings JSON (as returned by get_develop).

id.description: Photo id (default: the active photo). Makes that photo active first.
